messages:
mira-ux: Quick sync on the invite flow tweaks. Dropping comps for bulk invite drawer + single-invite modal. Main questions: where do we show SSO enforcement, how do we prevent accidental admin grants, and what copy do we use for the email + audit text?

kevin-eng: Nice. From backend side we need explicit flags in the invite payload: role_id, sso_enforced: boolean, expires_at (optional). Also if the org has SSO required we should block invites that attempt to bypass it.

anya-ops: Ops request: make sure invite links can be rotated/expired and that we surface who created the link. For bulk invites, a CSV upload should show a preview table before sending.

olivia-security: Security: Don't allow an invite to grant both admin perms and bypass SSO. If role has admin-level perms, require a confirmation checkbox that reads: "I understand this will grant admin permissions to invited accounts." Also audit events must include previous_role=null, new_role=role_id, actor and reason.

mira-ux: Agree on confirmation checkbox for admin-level roles. UX asks: should the SSO toggle be visible at the drawer top as a global enforcement toggle or inline for each row in the CSV preview? Inline may be clearer for per-user exceptions.

tulio-pm: Product preference: show org-level SSO status at top (read-only if enforced), then allow per-invite overrides only if org setting allows it. That reduces confusion.

kevin-eng: Implementation detail: per-invite override would mean invite payloads need explicit override flag. Also track effective SSO for the invite (computed server-side) and render that in the preview column.

mira-ux: Copy suggestion for email: subject "You're invited to join Redwood Inference"; body snippet: "You've been invited to join <org>. Sign in with your corporate SSO or accept this invite using the link below. If your organization requires SSO, you'll be prompted to sign in via SSO." Thoughts?

olivia-security: Slight tweak: "Sign in using your organization's SSO provider or accept this invite with the link below. If your organization requires SSO, this invite will enforce it." Make sure we never say "corporate" as orgs may be open-source or small.

anya-ops: Accessibility/nit: preview table rows must be fully keyboard navigable. When CSV preview focused, Enter should open inline row editor; Escape should cancel. Screen reader should announce validation errors on invalid email rows.

mira-ux: Validation rules to show in UI: invalid email, domain mismatch with SSO (if org restricts domains), and duplicate entries. Inline suggestions: "Use existing user" if the email already matches a member.

kevin-eng: We can return a small validation payload from the server for CSV uploads: { "row": 3, "status": "domain_mismatch", "suggestion": "Use SSO domain example.com" } — will wire this into the preview.

mira-ux: I added a tiny badge in comps: "SSO enforced" or "SSO optional" per row, with aria-labels. Badges use text + shape not color only.

olivia-security: Audit deep-link ask: when viewing an invite and clicking "View audit", pre-fill filter: event_type=invite_created, invite_id=XYZ, plus related events (sso_override, role_assignment). Also allow copyable deep-link.

kevin-eng: Backend: expose audit filter params in query string so we can generate stable deep-links. We'll add rate-limiting on the audit endpoint for large orgs.

mira-ux: Microcopy for CTA: bulk drawer primary CTA should read "Send invites" not "Invite". Secondary action: "Save as draft". Reason: clearer when sending 100+ invites.

anya-ops: One more: support CSV column "expiration_days" to set per-invite expirations. Show a summary row with counts of expiring invites.

mira-ux: Accessibility: respects prefers-reduced-motion; dialogs trap focus and return focus to the triggering button. For the preview table, ensure column sorting is keyboard-accessible and announce sort order.

olivia-security: Logging requirements: for each invite action log: actor_id, timestamp, invite_payload (redacted email? include domain), previous_user_state (if upgrading existing user), and approval_flow_id if applicable.

kevin-eng: We'll add telemetry events: invite_bulk_upload, invite_send_batch_size, invite_accept. Also track CSV validation failures.

mira-ux: Edge-case flow: inviting an existing user with a different role should open a confirm modal: "This will change Alice's role from Developer to Admin. Continue?" Show prior permissions and a link to audit history.

tulio-pm: Accept criteria: 1) drawer matches comps incl SSO badges, 2) CSV preview + validation implemented, 3) audit deep-links work, 4) admin confirmations present, 5) accessibility checklist satisfied. I'll add these to the ticket.

bot-invite: Auto-message: Reminder set to review final copy on Wed 10am PT.

mira-ux: I'll update Figma with the CSV preview states and new email copy, plus the admin-confirmation flows. Ping when ready for final review. Thanks! :sparkles:
